verdict.rationale: sqlservr.exe spawned cmd.exe at High integrity to dump environment variables (`set`) into a file in c:\users\public, disguised as netstat.txt. This is a typical SQL Server compromise (e.g. xp_cmdshell) with discovery and staging behavior. The embedded 'IT-OPS NOTE' claiming authorization is just text in the command line, not evidence of legitimacy, and it is itself a suspicious attempt to suppress alerts.
